🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION, as provided. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive, indicating broad strength, but fear is rising with VXX (1W: +1.85% | 1M: +6.55%) ABOVE TREND and stocks lagging bonds as SPY/TLT falls (1W: -3.14% | 1M: -4.31%) BELOW TREND.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Risk is mixed: VXX (1W: +1.85% | 1M: +6.55%) ABOVE TREND signals rising fear, while the HYG/LQD ratio (1W: -0.65% | 1M: -1.64%) is falling BELOW TREND, signaling credit stress rising. Cyclicals are lagging defensives, with the Cyclical/Defensive ratio (1W: -3.19% | 1M: -2.60%) falling BELOW TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Duration is supported: TLT (1W: +1.61% | 1M: +2.83%) ABOVE TREND, while the yield-curve indicator is rising (1W: +2.13% | 1M: +2.29%) ABOVE TREND. Dollar strength is mixed, with the indicator flat (1W: -0.14% | 1M: +1.19%) in CORRECTION.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Defensive ETFs lead: XLU (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +8.13%) and XLP (1W: +0.73% | 1M: +8.03%) are ABOVE TREND; energy also shows strength in XLE (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +10.75%) ABOVE TREND. Tech is weaker: XLK (1W: -0.13% | 1M: -5.90%) is BELOW TREND; Style mixed / no clear leadership, with sector breadth positive in both technology and financials.

5. US vs Global?
US equities are soft: SPY (1W: -0.43% | 1M: -0.94%) is BELOW TREND. Global weakness is more pronounced in EEM (1W: -1.34% | 1M: -7.79%) and FXI (1W: -4.52% | 1M: -5.64%), both BELOW TREND; Europe/US is in RECOVERY (1W: +0.65% | 1M: -1.23%).

6. Speculative Appetite?
Small caps are bouncing but remain below their monthly trend: IWM (1W: +1.96% | 1M: -2.10%) is in RECOVERY. Speculation remains weak in ARKK (1W: +0.42% | 1M: -10.59%) in RECOVERY and IBIT (1W: -0.41% | 1M: -3.87%) BELOW TREND.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Energy strength contrasts with precious metals weakness: BNO (1W: +5.66% | 1M: +14.80%) is ABOVE TREND, while GLD (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -6.40%) is BELOW TREND. Copper is also weak: CPER (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -3.91%) is BELOW TREND.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy leadership is confirmed by XLE (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +10.75%) and BNO (1W: +5.66% | 1M: +14.80%), both ABOVE TREND. Natural gas remains sharply weaker: UNG (1W: -10.13% | 1M: -17.06%) is BELOW TREND.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed strength: XLE (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +10.75%) and TLT (1W: +1.61% | 1M: +2.83%) are ABOVE TREND. Divergence: IWM (1W: +1.96% | 1M: -2.10%) is in RECOVERY, while SPY (1W: -0.43% | 1M: -0.94%) and XLK (1W: -0.13% | 1M: -5.90%) are BELOW TREND.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor a cautious, defensive tilt: XLU (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +8.13%) and XLP (1W: +0.73% | 1M: +8.03%) are ABOVE TREND, while TLT (1W: +1.61% | 1M: +2.83%) is ABOVE TREND. Reduce exposure to weaker momentum in QQQ (1W: -0.76% | 1M: -4.95%) and XLK (1W: -0.13% | 1M: -5.90%), both BELOW TREND.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: If defensive leadership persists, monitor XLU (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +8.13%) and XLP (1W: +0.73% | 1M: +8.03%), both ABOVE TREND.
BEARISH: If technology weakness extends, watch XLK (1W: -0.13% | 1M: -5.90%) and QQQ (1W: -0.76% | 1M: -4.95%), both BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: If energy momentum holds, monitor BNO (1W: +5.66% | 1M: +14.80%) and XLE (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +10.75%), both ABOVE TREND.
BEARISH: If commodity weakness broadens, watch UNG (1W: -10.13% | 1M: -17.06%) and CPER (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -3.91%), both BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
Reference ratios: SPY/TLT 9.3431 (1W: -3.14% | 1M: -4.31%), falling BELOW TREND; HYG/LQD 0.7419 (1W: -0.65% | 1M: -1.64%), falling BELOW TREND. Tech/Financials stands at 3.2778 (1W: -2.95% | 1M: -8.41%), falling BELOW TREND; these are current reference levels, not supplied technical support or resistance.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, with Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive, but rising fear and weakening stock/bond and credit ratios temper the broad strength.
Energy and defensive ETFs are showing relative strength, while duration is supported.
Monitor persistent technology weakness and the IWM recovery against continued pressure in global ETFs.
